title: feat(agents): preserve explicit shared environment bindings (#4074)
message:
feat(agents): preserve explicit shared environment bindings (#4074)

## Summary

Native shared installations lost software that was present only in an
author's custom Environment image. Sharing now binds the exact software
template recorded in the published Revision, with an independent Agent
and Sandbox for every recipient. There is no recipient share toggle and
no package-only rebuilding compatibility branch.

Reuse Engine's existing exact-version grants for org templates; global
templates use the global registry without a tenant grant. Persist
verified publisher ownership for later edits, copies and updates,
clearing stale ownership when the pin changes. Registry scope resolution
tries global only after a tenant 404, never another org or an
authorization/availability failure. Project-scope distribution remains
unsupported.

`environment/binding.json` is an authoring mechanism for selecting a
template during Settings commits; it is not required for sharing.
Credentials, channels, sessions and private Sandbox files stay
independent. Production inventory found 14 active published Agents and
56 share-install audit rows; all 14 published revisions already have
complete ID/version pins, and all four non-base templates are readable
and ready with matching declarations. No historic source rewrite is
needed.

The credential-free image is maintained in [Steward PR
#173](https://github.com/SerendipityOneInc/claw-steward/pull/173). This
backend must ship before selecting it through the new authoring source
path. No frontend or Engine deployment is required. Neither the
production backend nor the original Sherlock has been switched.

## Validation

- Astra independently reviewed the full implementation and fixes; the
global-registry regression and both ownership-lifecycle findings are
addressed. Subsequent test-isolation fixes also passed independent
review.
- Backend unit suite: 12,039 passed, 5 skipped; Ruff, format, Pyright
and import-linter passed. CI's missing-configuration failure was
isolated to a mocked installation test that still constructed a real
client; its corrected private-template pin assertions and 20 sharing
tests pass independently.
- Real staging Mongo/CSFLE, Redis, Engine and E2B exercised fresh share
installation, idempotent install replay, independent
runtimes/private-file isolation, fork followed by re-sharing, template
v1-to-v2 update with confirmation while another install retained v1, and
global-template share installation.
- Staging business code ran from this branch in an isolated subprocess
overlay, not a deployed HTTP service. Synthetic account eligibility and
dummy credentials were fixtures; no LLM turns or real customer
credentials were used. HTTP authentication, paid-model behavior and
production Sherlock diagnosis are not claimed by this smoke.
- All 11 disposable Agents from successful and earlier smoke attempts
were uninstalled and finalized through Engine's supported runtime
cleanup API. Independent PG verification found 11 deleted/stopped
runtimes and zero running Sandbox bindings (10 absent bindings).
Immutable template/grant history remains where Engine's retention guards
require it.

## Review disposition

The incremental CI Codex review still asks for the old package-only
rebuilding fallback. That assumption was explicitly superseded by the
requested product contract: Environment is a reusable template and every
share reuses the published exact pin. Astra independently reviewed this
revised contract and the full implementation, found the three previous
defects addressed, and found no remaining actionable defect. Published
production pins/readiness were inventoried before removing the old
behavior. Reintroducing the requested fallback would violate the agreed
uniform-template behavior.

`environment/binding.json` is an authoring mechanism for selecting a template during Settings commits; it is not required for sharing. Credentials, channels, sessions and private Sandbox files stay independent. No historic source rewrite is needed.

This backend must ship before selecting it through the new authoring source path. No frontend or Engine deployment is required. Neither the production backend nor the original Sherlock has been switched.

## Validation

- Backend unit suite: 12,039 passed, 5 skipped; Ruff, format, Pyright and import-linter passed. CI's missing-configuration failure was isolated to a mocked installation test that still constructed a real client; its corrected private-template pin assertions and 20 sharing tests pass independently.

author: lynn Zhuang
title: feat(design-system): 完善 2.1.0 组件目录与预览，标注 Chat UI 施工状态 (#4072)
message:
feat(design-system): 完善 2.1.0 组件目录与预览，标注 Chat UI 施工状态 (#4072)

## 概述

将本轮累计的设计系统补全、产品组件提取及预览修复整理为
**2.1.0**。解决预览与产品实现分离、组件目录缺失和交互示例不完整的问题；应用与预览逐步改为消费同一份共享实现。

**Chat UI 的 8
个预览模块全部标记「施工中」**，并同步显示在侧边目录、搜索结果和模块标题处。其样式与交互仍待校准，本次纳入目录不代表已完成最终验收。

## 主要改动

- 补全品牌、字体、图标、插画及来源登记；增加官网导航、页脚、社交链接和语言切换示例。
- 增加官网与工作区 Layout、响应式网格、Splitter、Calendar、Carousel、Statistic 和渐变
Sparkline。
- 提取产品导航、连接卡片、更新按钮/徽标、图标操作和 Paper Focus 主题；保留业务侧路由、请求与权限回调。
- 重整组件分类，将 Tabs / Segmented 归为同一展示家族，保留各自语义 API；完善切换动效、Tooltip 方位与间距。
- 增加固定全局通知，区分 Alert、GlobalAlert 和 Toast；通知操作置于右侧并压缩高度。
- 增加双语组件搜索、固定高度弹窗、目录滚动同步和 React · Web 标识；修复布局裁切、对齐和分割线样式。
- Chat UI 预览复用聊天包，覆盖输入框、Mentions、选择器、消息、附件、执行状态、富内容卡片与任务模板；修复 Mention
按钮误触发表单提交。
- 更新版本号、预览内 Changelog 和 CHANGELOG.md，保留 2.0.0 历史记录。

## 接入方式与边界

- 仓库内通过 `workspace:*` 使用 `@zooclaw/design-system`，聊天组合组件通过
`@zooclaw/chat-ui` 使用。
- README 记录 CSS、Tailwind 扫描、主题标记、布局插槽和组件示例；SOURCE_MAP.md 记录已共享与尚未迁移的实现。
- 当前仍是 private 工作区源码包，**本 PR 不发布 npm
包**。外部仓库可临时纳入源码工作区；长期接入需另建构建、类型/样式/资源打包和私有 registry 发布流程。
- 官网展示层、业务 Layout 和部分新组件的产品迁移状态见 SOURCE_MAP.md；预览示例使用本地数据，不发起真实聊天、上传或授权。

## 验证

- [x] 设计系统：455 项测试、类型检查、lint、预览构建通过（同步 main 前的完整验证）。
- [x] Chat UI：类型检查、lint 通过；本轮实现期间已验证相关聊天测试。
- [x] 同步最新 main 后，保留已合入的键盘焦点修复；共享组件 22 项、应用按钮/主题 24 项回归测试通过。
- [x] 浏览器检查 8 个模块的施工标识、中英文展示、标题样式与横向溢出。
- [x] 首轮 CI 问题修复：为 4 个交互卡片声明客户端边界，清理迁移后遗留依赖与包装组件，同步测试 mock 和共享资源路径；7
个应用测试文件共 263 项、聊天包相关 20 项测试通过，Knip 门禁通过。
- [x] 最新提交 `2bf9d6591` 的 GitHub CI
全部适用检查通过：主应用完整测试、静态检查、生产构建，以及管理后台、控制台、平台与 CodeQL 检查。本地生产编译遇到 Google
Fonts 下载超时，生产构建结论以 CI 为准。
- [x] 推送门禁：治理检查、应用 TypeScript 和 ESLint 全部通过；GitHub CI 结果以本 PR 检查列表为准。

## 审阅重点与体量说明

本次按需求整体提交此前累计的组件库建设，包含共享源码迁移、目录重组、测试、文档及品牌资产，超过默认 PR 行数阈值，使用
`size-override`。保留其他质量检查。建议按共享组件/主题 → 应用适配器 → 预览/资产的顺序审阅。

共享主题和基础组件会影响实际产品页面，请重点核对导航、菜单焦点、聊天工具栏及连接卡片。Chat UI 后续视觉校准继续单独推进。

自动审阅说明：Claude 抽查未发现可复现缺陷，因改动体量和 Mention / 中文输入法交互建议人工验收；Codex 自动审阅因 diff
过大跳过。本 PR 尚未合并，也未发布 npm 包。

author: finn-srp
title: feat(platform): allow owners to rename their organization (#4066)
message:
feat(platform): allow owners to rename their organization (#4066)

## Summary

Platform owners currently get an Organization named `Personal` with no
way to change it. Add `POST /platform/v1/organization/update` and a name
input with Save in Organization General settings. New Organizations
still default to `Personal`.

The endpoint derives the Organization from the verified Platform
session, accepts only `name`, trims whitespace, and enforces 1–100
Unicode code points. A single atomic Mongo update filters by
Organization ID, owner UID and active status, preserving Project,
API-key and billing associations. The frontend updates bootstrap through
the scope provider, retains failed drafts for explicit retry, and
disables editing during save. If a save finishes after sign-out and
re-login, the unmounted provider returns before cancelling or modifying
the new session bootstrap; it checks again after awaiting cancellation.

## Test plan

- [x] Organization tests pass independently (7 cases), including late
save completion after sign-out, same-account re-login with an in-flight
bootstrap, and Project pagination preservation. The re-login regression
test fails against the previous provider implementation. Initialize the
sign-out mock in each test group so these tests do not depend on
execution order.
- [x] Node 24: Platform `pnpm lint`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test` (290
tests), and `pnpm build`, on final merge commit `b636ea5a2` after
merging current `origin/main`.
- [x] `ecap-verify-py-ci` on final merge commit `b636ea5a2` after
merging current `origin/main`: Linux dependency resolution, static
checks, all ci-lint guards, both duplication checks, and the full
4-worker pytest/coverage gate (12,267 passed, 5 skipped; coverage
89.65%, threshold 89.5%).
- [x] Local browser preview: save, reload persistence, desktop/mobile
layouts; no horizontal mobile overflow or browser errors.
- [ ] Staging encrypted-client and authenticated frontend/backend
integration verification before release. Local Mongo tests and the UI
preview do not establish CSFLE runtime compatibility.

The legacy pre-commit `check-user` hook requires a GitHub login ending
in `-srp`, which conflicts with this workspace's required Finn account
(`finn930`). Only that hook was skipped; all quality hooks ran, and the
commit author is `finn-srp <finn@srp.one>`.

---------

Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

The endpoint derives the Organization from the verified Platform session, accepts only `name`, trims whitespace, and enforces 1–100 Unicode code points. A single atomic Mongo update filters by Organization ID, owner UID and active status, preserving Project, API-key and billing associations. The frontend updates bootstrap through the scope provider, retains failed drafts for explicit retry, and disables editing during save. If a save finishes after sign-out and re-login, the unmounted provider returns before cancelling or modifying the new session bootstrap; it checks again after awaiting cancellation.

## Test plan

- [x] Organization tests pass independently (7 cases), including late save completion after sign-out, same-account re-login with an in-flight bootstrap, and Project pagination preservation. The re-login regression test fails against the previous provider implementation. Initialize the sign-out mock in each test group so these tests do not depend on execution order.
- [x] Node 24: Platform `pnpm lint`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test` (290 tests), and `pnpm build`, on final merge commit `b636ea5a2` after merging current `origin/main`.
- [x] `ecap-verify-py-ci` on final merge commit `b636ea5a2` after merging current `origin/main`: Linux dependency resolution, static checks, all ci-lint guards, both duplication checks, and the full 4-worker pytest/coverage gate (12,267 passed, 5 skipped; coverage 89.65%, threshold 89.5%).

author: lynn Zhuang
title: feat(agents): 添加旧版 Agent 下线提示并统一页面布局 (#4070)
message:
feat(agents): 添加旧版 Agent 下线提示并统一页面布局 (#4070)

## 变更说明

为旧版 Agent 项目页面增加常驻下线提示，告知用户旧版构建功能即将下线、已创建的 Agent
仍可正常使用，继续构建可联系客服。提示在项目列表及详情页持续显示，滚动内容时保持可见；“联系客服”沿用官网 footer 的
`mailto:support@zooclaw.ai`，由系统默认邮件应用打开草稿。

内页标题和浏览器标签统一为入口名称 `Legacy agent projects`，内容宽度、标题字号和按钮尺寸与 Agents
页对齐，并新增“返回 Agents”入口。下线提示及返回文案支持中英文。

## 验证

- [x] 提交前已同步最新 main（`50445b1be`），无冲突。
- [x] 本地治理检查、TypeScript 和 ESLint 通过，提交及推送钩子通过。
- [x] 旧版项目首页、入口、重定向及官网 footer 共 86 项相关测试通过。
- [x] 浏览器验证桌面及移动端、中英文、深浅色模式、滚动时提示常驻，以及返回 Agents 的导航。
- [x] 实测内容宽度、标题字号和按钮尺寸与 Agents 页一致；联系链接地址与 footer 一致。未自动化验证系统邮件应用的实际唤起。

仅涉及前端，无需后端部署或数据迁移。

## 自动评审核对

- CI 已完成，所有实际运行的检查通过；未命中的检查按工作流规则跳过。CodeQL 未发现本 PR 的未处理告警，Codex 评审未发现问题。
- Claude
建议确认横幅是否应覆盖项目详情页：这是本次既定设计。旧版列表、项目详情及该路由下的页面共用提示，确保直接进入旧项目的用户也能看到下线说明。横幅占用布局高度，内容在剩余空间内滚动；移动端顶部留白用于避让应用菜单。
- Claude 提及中文字典中既有的英文 `Legacy agent
projects`：本次按要求复用入口的同一字段，确保入口与内页名称一致，因此保留现有命名。
- 两条建议均不涉及已确认的功能缺陷，未追加代码修改；PR 保持打开，等待人工审核。

内页标题和浏览器标签统一为入口名称 `Legacy agent projects`，内容宽度、标题字号和按钮尺寸与 Agents 页对齐，并新增“返回 Agents”入口。下线提示及返回文案支持中英文。

仅涉及前端，无需后端部署或数据迁移。

## 自动评审核对

- CI 已完成，所有实际运行的检查通过；未命中的检查按工作流规则跳过。CodeQL 未发现本 PR 的未处理告警，Codex 评审未发现问题。
- Claude 建议确认横幅是否应覆盖项目详情页：这是本次既定设计。旧版列表、项目详情及该路由下的页面共用提示，确保直接进入旧项目的用户也能看到下线说明。横幅占用布局高度，内容在剩余空间内滚动；移动端顶部留白用于避让应用菜单。

title: feat(enterprise): require company and validate work email (#4044)
message:
feat(enterprise): require company and validate work email (#4044)

## Summary
Require a Company name in the enterprise Contact sales form and include
it as `company` in the existing `/business/contact` request. Block
common personal email domains on submit with “Please use your business
email address.”, retaining inputs for correction. Existing consultation
options and submission lifecycle are preserved.

Add localized company labels and validation feedback for all supported
business-page locales, plus accessible field errors and regression
coverage.

## Validation
- 19 related unit tests passed, including personal email rejection,
required company, request payload, retry, duplicate submission
prevention, and demo navigation.
- Scoped ESLint and frontend governance guards passed.
- Local browser verified the Company field and personal-email rejection.
- Full TypeScript check could not pass with the reused local
dependencies: missing fast-xml-parser, cron-parser, cronstrue, and yaml
modules. CI should verify against the pinned installation.

## Backend compatibility and deployment
The backend request schema now accepts an optional, trimmed company name
(1–200 characters when supplied), preserving existing clients that omit
it. Existing application-log recording includes company automatically;
the sales Feishu notification includes the company name. Unknown fields
remain forbidden.

Deploy the backend before the frontend to prevent the previously
deployed schema rejecting the new company property with HTTP 422. Both
frontend and backend deployment are required.

## Review fix validation
- 39 backend contact endpoint tests passed, including the actual
frontend payload, trimmed company in logs and notification,
invalid-company rejection, and legacy requests without company.
- Frontend CI lint/typecheck, tests, and build passed on the initial
revision.

## Contact form error-state fix
After a failed backend request, rejecting a personal email now clears
the obsolete request-failure alert and shows only the business-email
correction message. Form values and email focus are preserved, and a
corrected business email can retry successfully.

Validation:
- Added a regression test for failed request → personal-email rejection
→ corrected retry; confirmed it fails before the fix and passes
afterward. The rejected attempt sends no additional request.
- All 20 related contact and demo-navigation tests pass under Node 24.
- Scoped ESLint and all seven frontend governance guards pass.
- Full local TypeScript checking remains limited by the reused
dependency installation missing fast-xml-parser, cron-parser, cronstrue,
and yaml; CI uses the pinned installation.

---------

author: anna-srp
title: feat(marketing): feature the NYC hackathon event (#4062)
message:
feat(marketing): feature the NYC hackathon event (#4062)

## What

Updates the upcoming New York event from its placeholder state to the
official **Fashion and Finance Hackathon with ZooWork** listing.

- Adds the official AI Tinkerers event URL and a visible **View event
details** link.
- Features the supplied event artwork in a responsive upcoming-event
card.
- Serves the artwork as an optimized WebP asset (about 196 KB) while
preserving its full composition.
- Includes the event URL and artwork in the generated Event JSON-LD.
- Updates the event maintenance guide and unit coverage.

Event page:
https://nyc.aitinkerers.org/p/fashion-and-finance-hackathon-with-zoowork

## Validation

- Event URL returns HTTP 200 and its title matches the page copy.
- Local desktop and narrow-screen previews render the full artwork
without cropping its title, date, or partner logos.
- `events-schema.unit.spec.ts`: 12 tests passed.
- Prettier, ESLint, and `tsc --noEmit` passed for the changed files.

---------

Co-authored-by: Yueru Wang <yueruwang@Yuerus-MacBook-Air.local>
